_about: Scoring thresholds for the AI adoption assessment. RUBRIC.md explains each rule in plain words; keep the two in step. Raise 'version' whenever a rule, threshold or checklist changes, so trend reports can tell rule changes from real change.
levelReachedWhen: at least half of the level's practices count (rounded up: 1 of 2, 2 of 3, 2 of 4, 3 of 6)

decision.meets: all must-have criteria present and not lower-level use
decision.doesNotMeet: two or more missing, lower-level use, or rejected by the quality filter
